Lindsell Train LTD Has Increased Dr Pepper Snapple Group (DPS) Stake by $59.99 Million; Becker Capital Management Has Boosted Its At&T (T) Position by $4.24 Million; Share Price Declined 
April 18, 2018 - By Nellie Frank 
Becker Capital Management Inc increased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 9.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Becker Capital Management Inc bought 111,553 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.29M shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $49.97M, up from 1.17 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Becker Capital Management Inc who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $229.67B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.79% or $0.28 during the last trading session, reaching $35.36. About 20.59 million shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% since April 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500. 
Lindsell Train Ltd increased its stake in Dr Pepper Snapple Group Inc (DPS) by 23.76% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lindsell Train Ltd bought 618,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 23.05% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 3.22 million shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $312.74M, up from 2.60 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lindsell Train Ltd who had been investing in Dr Pepper Snapple Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $21.69 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.31% or $0.37 during the last trading session, reaching $120.67. About 1.13M shares traded. Dr Pepper Snapple Group, Inc. (NYSE:DPS) has risen 21.65% since April 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.10% the S&P500. 
Among 31 analysts covering AT&T Inc. ( NYSE:T ), 12 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 39% are positive. AT&T Inc. had 78 analyst reports since July 27, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was downgraded by Oppenheimer to “Perform” on Tuesday, November 8. UBS downgraded it to “Neutral” rating and $43 target in Wednesday, September 28 report. The stock of AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) earned “Buy” rating by Deutsche Bank on Tuesday, June 28. DA Davidson maintained the shares of T in report on Monday, March 7 with “Buy” rating. The stock of AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) earned “Outperform” rating by Wells Fargo on Wednesday, April 12. The firm has “Neutral” rating by Bank of America given on Thursday, July 13. Cowen & Co maintained AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) rating on Monday, September 18. Cowen & Co has “Hold” rating and $41.0 target. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Wednesday, January 11 by Deutsche Bank. The stock of AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) earned “Neutral” rating by Buckingham Research on Friday, June 24. The stock of AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) earned “Overweight” rating by Barclays Capital on Monday, April 18. 
Becker Capital Management Inc, which manages about $3.03 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Johnson & Johnson Com (NYSE:JNJ) by 8,116 shares to 425,199 shares, valued at $59.41M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Imax Corp (NYSE:IMAX) by 168,760 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 810,995 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Computer Inc Com (NASDAQ:AAPL).
